verses.ma-balu-dhi-ghadabin-alayka-hasudi-c1-v1: mā bal- dhī ghaḍabi ʿalayka ḥasūdi ʾidh mā ʾutīta bimanṣabi maḥmūdi
verses.ma-balu-dhi-ghadabin-alayka-hasudi-c1-v2: falikulli mustanimi bisaʿyika ʾuswatu walikulli marʾi fīka khayru mazīdi
verses.ma-balu-dhi-ghadabin-alayka-hasudi-c1-v3: ʾawfayta ʿahdaka lil-khalīfati baʿdamā qad shāʿa ghayruka min dhawī t-taqlīdi
verses.ma-balu-dhi-ghadabin-alayka-hasudi-c1-v4: madḥā wadhammā qad samiʿta walam takun mimman yubālī qawlata liḥuqūdi
verses.ma-balu-dhi-ghadabin-alayka-hasudi-c1-v5: faʾatayta mushtamila l-makārimi wāqifā bidharāhu bādhila ṭārifi watalīdi
verses.ma-balu-dhi-ghadabin-alayka-hasudi-c1-v6: falaʾanta tulfā fal-ja bna ḥalāwati mimmā yuʿāfu biẓillinā l-mamdūdi
verses.ma-balu-dhi-ghadabin-alayka-hasudi-c1-v7: yā manṣu ʾinnaka lā tushābahu rifʿaha ʾidh kunta muntasibā lidhī t-tawḥīdi
verses.ma-balu-dhi-ghadabin-alayka-hasudi-c1-v8: ʾinna l-ʿamāmata lā tuqāribu man ʾatā yabghī t-taqarruba minka yā dhā l-jūdi
verses.ma-balu-dhi-ghadabin-alayka-hasudi-c1-v9: ʾidhā mā hudīta kulla muwaffaqi lil-hudā hadyā l-ʿīlimi ṣ-ṣindīdi
verses.ma-balu-dhi-ghadabin-alayka-hasudi-c1-v1: ḥattā kaʾanna sanāka ʿamma mashāriqā wamaghāribā fī l-ʾarḍi mithla suʿūdi
fī l-badhli ʾanta kamā l-ḥayā wabiḥikmahi kal-baḥri ʾidh fī l-ḥilmi kal-julmūdi
wāfayta dāʾirata l-ʾiḥāṭati mughramā bisumā yahhuzu ḍarāʾiba l-maʿbūdi
lawlā taqaṣṣuru julli ʾahli bilādinā layakūnu minka lahum jazāʾu wadūdi
fāʿlam waʿilmu l-marʾi ʾanfaʿu mā ḥawā ʾan lā ʾazālu lakum ʾabarra walīdi
faʿalā n-nabiyyī muḥammadi wal-ʾāli maʿ ṣaḥbi salāmā llāhi dhī t-tamjīdi
